name: Alabama

statute.name: Alabama Public Records Law
statute.citation: Ala. Code § 36-12-40 et seq. (procedure at §§ 36-12-43 to -45)

response.rule_text: An officer must acknowledge a request within 10 business days (Ala. Code § 36-12-44(a)(3)) and give a substantive response to a standard request within 15 business days of acknowledgment (§ 36-12-44(a)(4)); time-intensive requests get 45 business days after the requester elects to proceed (§ 36-12-44(b)(4)).

fees.labor_rule: No statutory schedule; AG opinions imply a search fee if substantial employee time is required. Executive branch (EO 734): up to $20/hour for retrieval and preparation.
fees.copy_rule: No statutory copy schedule; fee must be reasonable. Executive branch (EO 734): up to $0.50 per standard page, no per-page fee for electronic records provided electronically.
fees.waiver_rule: Fees may be waived for 'standard' requests needing under 8 hours of staff time, Ala. Code § 36-12-44(a)(2).
fees.late_penalty: None: the Public Records Law has no fines or penalties for violations.

residency.rule_text: Only a 'resident' (individual permanently domiciled in Alabama) may request, Ala. Code § 36-12-43(b)(3); officer may ask for reasonable evidence of residency, § 36-12-44(f).

appeal.rule_text: Alabama has no administrative appeal and the AG has no enforcement role (advisory opinions only); enforcement is by civil suit. Failure to respond within the time limits creates a rebuttable presumption of denial, § 36-12-44(a)(5), (b)(6).

exemptions_citation: Ala. Code § 36-12-40(a) (library records; security plans), plus many other statutes and common-law grounds
format_rule: Statute silent on requester-chosen format; AG opinions say agency need not provide a specific form, and requester may use own copying equipment unless it unduly interferes.
notes: Appeal deadline null: no administrative appeal. Governor/legislature coverage is 'presumptive' per RCFP (law silent). Universities and school districts not confirmed from raw RCFP text. 2024 amendments; statute text not fetched from legislature site.
